scope: Retire automatic and persisted NGE Force Sensitive stance/focus, Smuggler Underworld expertise passives, and Commando kill-meter player state while preserving Publish 14.1 skill-box progression, the distinct PRE-CU brawler Center of Being lifecycle, Smuggler title/reward quests, NPC behavior, and retained expansion data.

findings: Publish 14.1 player progression is driven by independently learned skill boxes rather than NGE class and expertise trees.
The inherited automatic fs_buff_ca_1/fs_buff_def_1_1 and sm_underworld_* application paths read NGE expertise modifiers and are not Publish 14.1 profession passives.
The NGE stance handler can rehydrate expertise-derived child buffs and modifiers from persisted parent state even when every fs_* player action is centrally denied.

The inherited NGE Commando kill meter has independent native, damage, XP-kill, GCW-kill, and command writers; retained compatibility attacks could mutate a restored PRE-CU Commando defender unless player identity is denied at the meter boundary.

The authenticated PRE-CU Center of Being uses the separate centerOfBeing command, centerofbeing buff, and brawler efficacy/duration skill modifiers; it does not use either NGE Force Sensitive stance parent.
Later buff, effect-mapping, quest, and zone data can remain loadable for NPC and expansion compatibility without granting player progression authority.
